about.description: SoapySDR is an open-source generalized API and runtime library for interfacing with SDR devices. With SoapySDR, you can instantiate, configure, and stream with an SDR device in a variety of environments. Most off the shelf SDR hardware platforms are supported by SoapySDR, and many open source applications rely on SoapySDR for hardware integration support. In additon, SoapySDR has bindings for development frameworks like GNU Radio and Pothos.
about.summary: Vendor and platform neutral SDR support library

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.9.0"

package:
  name: soapysdr
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/pothosware/SoapySDR/archive/soapy-sdr-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 64f97c1ad241156fe299acb8902169019eab34517cd580b563968a43d7533509
  patches:
    - 0001-Use-full-Python-extension-suffix-for-the-module.patch
    - 0002-cmake-Add-option-to-specify-Python-module-installati.patch

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - swig
    # cross-compilation dependencies
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    # Since Python 3.15 libpython is a separate package, and apparently this
    # SWIG binding links to it unlike a typical Python extension module
    - libpython
    - python
  run:
    - libpython
    - python
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("soapysdr", upper_bound="x.x") }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - SoapySDRUtil
      include:
        - SoapySDR/**
        - SoapySDR/Version.h
        - SoapySDR/Version.hpp
      lib:
        - SoapySDR
      files:
        - ${{ "Lib/" if (win and match(python, "<3.15")) else "lib/python*" }}site-packages/*SoapySDR*
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/pkgconfig/SoapySDR.pc
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}share/man/man1/SoapySDRUtil.1
        - if: unix
          then: share/cmake/SoapySDR/*.cmake
          else: Library/cmake/SoapySDR*.cmake
  - script:
      - SoapySDRUtil --info
  - python:
      imports:
        - SoapySDR
      pip_check: false

about:
  license: BSL-1.0
  license_file: LICENSE_1_0.txt
  summary: Vendor and platform neutral SDR support library
  description: >
    SoapySDR is an open-source generalized API and runtime library for interfacing with
    SDR devices. With SoapySDR, you can instantiate, configure, and stream with an SDR
    device in a variety of environments. Most off the shelf SDR hardware platforms are
    supported by SoapySDR, and many open source applications rely on SoapySDR for
    hardware integration support. In additon, SoapySDR has bindings for development
    frameworks like GNU Radio and Pothos.
  homepage: https://github.com/pothosware/SoapySDR/wiki
  repository: https://github.com/pothosware/SoapySDR
  documentation: https://github.com/pothosware/SoapySDR/wiki

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ryanvolz
